submitted.rationale: At 2.06 eV, BiVO4 (Eg ~2.4 eV) absorbs little, so the most likely photoactive phases are the Cu vanadates. XRD on #58 showed a large amount of Cu-vanadate phase mixed with BiVO4. #58 and #22 both measured 1e-8 A, which is the floor. #89 measured 0 A. #58 ties for best measured and has the most Cu-vanadate character, so I chose it over #22.

rejected.reason: V-rich BiVO4/V-oxide mixture; photocurrent 1e-8 A, the same as #58 at the floor
Cu/Bi-rich, V-poor mixed phase (CuBi2O4-like/CuO); photocurrent 0 A, as expected for a p-type/photocathode-type phase
XRD shows mostly BiVO4, whose band gap is above 2.06 eV, so little light is absorbed; not measured for photocurrent
XRD shows BiVO4-dominated mixture with a small extra phase; not measured for photocurrent
